title: Frosty-XSX-Shipping.exe
source: The supplied title symbol map and PE code identify the producer. FXboxCommonD3D12DynamicRHI::CreateCommandContext writes 0x12000000 into +0x3e68 at RVA 0x5752708. Five FD3D12DescriptorCache::SetSRVs permutations combine this value with 0xc0 for a flagged shader-resource view. Permutation 5 combines it with 0x40. Other branches select ordinary SRV or depth read states. Individual high-bit names remain unknown.
scope: Only these two exact encodings. Existing buffer-only bits on texture states retain their previous treatment.

gpu_tests.scope: Draw two distinct 32x32 RGBA images via point sampling, with COPY_DEST writes and transitions back to read. Both readbacks include all pixels. Every command list close and fence passed. The 0x40 state was entered and left by the graphics guest.

compute_validation.scope: An Xbox compute dispatch executes 1,024 texture loads after a GPU copy in state 0x12000040. Pixel shaders read 2,048 texels across two images before and after the GPU copy. The command list also returns from each translated state.
